_comment: Ground truth for the MPU redzone oracle on STM32F446: an MPU no-access region (AP=000, 32B, PRIVDEFENA) placed over a guard immediately after a buffer turns a 1-byte overflow into a PRECISE MemManage fault. This is what makes a sanitizer-class redzone oracle hardware-replayable (T2) under an MPU harness.

stack_overflow_into_mpu_guard.note: MPU no-access 512B region below the stack; a recursion-driven overflow faults precisely in it. The Cortex-M4 has no MSPLIM, so this MPU region is how a stack overflow earns a hardware-replayable (T2) result.
